notes: Exclusion code system (6). The work proposes PROBE/PB-O-GAR, a private band-limited over-the-air gradient aggregation rule for federated learning with AirComp (area 7), so it passes no_learning, above_phy and function. But the link is single-antenna with no RIS: p. 4: "ci is the time-invariant channel state information (CSI) of device i" and "we consider real channel coefficients, i.e., ci ∈ R+", with received signal y(tau) = sum_i ci xi(tau) + z(tau) (Eq. 9-10), a scalar multiple-access channel; p. 12: "ci = 0.8 for ∀i ∈ [m]". The whole text was searched and never mentions antennas, MIMO, beamforming or a RIS. The antenna count is not stated in words, so the single-antenna reading rests on the scalar channel model; the reviewer should confirm it. For reference, the experiments (p. 12-15) use MNIST and CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, an abstract AirComp channel with no 3GPP or measured model, and report training loss and privacy loss against DPRP-FedSGD, so the results check would pass.
